# Gergely Peidl

> Lead DevOps & Cloud Infrastructure Engineer in Budapest, Hungary with 13+ years of experience. Started as a full stack software engineer (mostly frontend), now leads a cloud infrastructure team. Focus: AWS, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, automation. Automation enthusiast with a production-grade Kubernetes homelab and a Home Assistant / ESPHome smart home.

Primary site: https://peidl.net/
